title: Nectarous Dutch Rose Pancakes
description: Floral, fluffy Dutch pancakes with a hint of rose, perfect for a romantic date night and low-FODMAP friendly.
instructions: In a bowl whisk together oat flour, baking powder, salt, and cinnamon.
In a separate bowl whisk the warm water, egg, honey, vanilla extract, and rose water.
Pour the wet mixture into the dry mixture and whisk until smooth.
Add the edible rose petals and fold them gently into the batter.
Heat a non-stick skillet over medium heat and melt the coconut oil.
Pour 1/4 cup of batter onto the skillet for each pancake and swirl to form a circle.
Cook until bubbles form and edges dry, about 2 minutes.
Flip the pancake and cook for another 2 minutes until golden.
Repeat with remaining batter, adding more coconut oil as needed.
Serve warm with a drizzle of honey and a dusting of powdered sugar if desired.
